text:
maria-cs: Quick sync — ACME dedicated bring-up: quota stress handoff. We need final agreement on autoscale policy, load-test windows, and customer-facing validation. Who can own the 9-11am PT slot tomorrow?

sanjay-ops: I can own 9-11. Will run shadow replayer + ramp script from infra side.

tasha-se: Thx. Need the exact QPS targets and burst profile. ACME asked for steady at ~75% of reserved pool, with 3x bursts lasting ~3m every 30m for the first 2 hours. Confirming their expected token mix (many short chat turns).

adrian-ml: Model details for the run: opt-6.7b quantized (4-bit), KV cache priming required for chat use. Target p50 latency 120ms, p95 < 350ms. If p95 exceeds that we flag immediately.

eli-rl: Agree on pre-warm. Plan: prefix priming with synthetic prefixes matching their prompts, then ramp to steady QPS. I'll post the replayer command shortly.

maria-cs: Also capture enablement touchpoints: 1) post-test prompt-eval with ACME prompt set; 2) CS checklist for renewal risks; 3) short customer demo of warmup behavior. Katie can coordinate.

katie-cs: I can run the post-test eval and collect annotations. Will prep a short Google Form for quick quality feedback (latency, correctness, hallucination flag).

deploy-bot: Scheduled window created: dedicated-pool-acme - 2025-01-17T16:00:00Z to 2025-01-17T18:00:00Z (2h). Owner: sanjay-ops.

sanjay-ops: Replayer snippet (will run from infra-loadbox, logs to s3):

```
# example replayer command
python tools/replayer.py \
  --acct acme-corp \
  --model opt-6.7b-4bit \
  --qps 120 \
  --burst-qps 360 \
  --burst-duration 180 \
  --steady-duration 5400 \
  --seed 42 \
  --out s3://redwood-load/acme/2025-01-17/
```

eli-rl: Will add KV prime script before ramp: `scripts/prime_kv.sh --account acme --prefix-file prompts/acme_seed.txt`

tasha-se: Ops notes: autoscale policy to use: min_instances=4, target_util=0.75, max_instances=20. Add a cooldown 120s to avoid flapping during 3m bursts. We'll monitor token throttles per-route.

adrian-ml: Suggest quantization fallback plan: if p95 > 500ms for >3 consecutive 5m windows, fallback to opt-6.7b-q2 if available; otherwise route to a smaller model with degradation notice to ACME. Documented in the runbook.

maria-cs: Risk capture: if throughput or quality is below threshold, we mark renewal risk level moderate and schedule an enablement call. Also capture any billing anomalies during heavy bursts.

katie-cs: I'll prepare the short eval: 25 prompts sampled from their traffic plus 10 adversarial prompts. Post results in the thread within 2 hours of test finish.

eli-rl: Monitoring hooks to add to the run: token-level latency histogram, cache hit ratio, per-model gRPC errors, request queue depth. Send alerts to #eng-oncall and #customer-success if p95 latency > 400ms or error rate > 0.5%.

sanjay-ops: Ops checklist for tomorrow:
- confirm replayer binary on loadbox (:heavy_check_mark:)
- verify IAM for s3 write (:heavy_check_mark:)
- deploy autoscale policy to test env then prod (:hourglass:)
- smoke warmup sequence 30m prior to main run (:soon:)

maria-cs: OK — owners: sanjay = run + infra, eli = priming scripts, tasha = SLO guardrails, adrian = model fallback plan, katie = post-test eval + customer feedback. I'll draft a short email to ACME with the timeline + what to expect. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Run started: 2025-01-17T16:00:00Z (will post logs).

sanjay-ops: Starting warmup now, posting live logs to s3. Ping here with anomalies.

katie-cs: Post-test survey link: https://forms.gle/acme-eval-2025 (will send to ACME 30m after end).

maria-cs: Thanks team — we'll reconvene in this thread after the run for the retro and renewal-readout.
